about: RQ-237 第 2 批:上线清单(launch_check.py 读)。auto 项由脚本在预览或正式站上查;manual 项脚本查不了,列出来写负责人和截止日。owner 是默认负责角色,用户在 seo-ops/plan/launch-owners.json 里写 {"<id>": "张三"} 覆盖;due 同理写 {"<id>@due": "2026-12-01"}。severity:block 不过不能上线,warn 上线后两周内补,info 可选。出处:Google 搜索中心的 SEO 入门指南、robots / sitemap / canonical / hreflang / 结构化数据文档,以及公开的网站上线 SEO 清单(v9digital,核对 2026-11-08);具体判据写在 references/lifecycle/stage-1-prelaunch.md。

items.title: 首页返回 200
items.title_en: Homepage returns 200

items.title: 正式站走 HTTPS,HTTP 跳到 HTTPS
items.title_en: Production uses HTTPS; HTTP redirects to HTTPS

items.title: robots.txt 存在且没有全站 Disallow
items.title_en: robots.txt exists and does not disallow the whole site

items.title: 抽查页没有 noindex(预发环境的封锁上线时要撤)
items.title_en: Sampled pages have no noindex (remove staging blocks at launch)

items.title: sitemap 能读到、至少 1 条 URL、在 robots.txt 里声明
items.title_en: Sitemap is readable, has at least one URL and is declared in robots.txt

items.title: 抽查页有 canonical,是绝对地址,指向正式域名
items.title_en: Sampled pages have an absolute canonical pointing to the production domain

items.title: 抽查页 title 和 meta description 都有、互不重复
items.title_en: Sampled pages have unique titles and meta descriptions

items.title: 抽查页各有 1 个 H1
items.title_en: Each sampled page has one H1

items.title: html 标签写了 lang
items.title_en: The html element declares lang

items.title: 多语言站:hreflang 列出自身、用完整地址(x-default 建议加)
items.title_en: Multilingual sites: hreflang lists itself with full URLs (x-default recommended)

items.title: 首页有 Organization 或 WebSite 结构化数据
items.title_en: Homepage has Organization or WebSite structured data

items.title: 首页有 og:title 和绝对地址的 og:image
items.title_en: Homepage has og:title and an absolute og:image

items.title: 有 viewport meta
items.title_en: Viewport meta is present

items.title: 不存在的地址返回 404,不是 200(软 404)
items.title_en: Unknown URLs return 404, not 200 (soft 404)

items.title: 首页响应 < 800 ms(本地预览只作参考,上线后看 CWV 实测)
items.title_en: Homepage responds in under 800 ms (local preview is indicative only)

items.title: 有 llms.txt(可选,Google 搜索不需要)
items.title_en: llms.txt exists (optional; not needed for Google Search)

items.title: robots.txt 对 AI 爬虫的放行是有意定的
items.title_en: robots.txt AI crawler rules are a deliberate decision

items.title: 有 favicon(搜索结果里显示)
items.title_en: Favicon exists (shown in search results)

items.title: GSC 域名资源验证(DNS TXT),上线当天提交 sitemap
items.title_en: GSC domain property verified (DNS TXT); submit the sitemap on launch day

items.title: Bing Webmaster 验证(可从 GSC 导入),开 IndexNow
items.title_en: Bing Webmaster verified (can import from GSC); enable IndexNow

items.title: 主转化事件埋好,在预览上触发一次能记到
items.title_en: Primary conversion event fires once on the preview and is recorded

items.title: 替换旧站时:有点击的旧 URL 全部有 301 映射
items.title_en: When replacing an old site: every old URL with clicks has a 301

items.title: 社媒主页和目录站的名称、简介和官网一致
items.title_en: Social and directory profiles match the site name and description

items.title: 关于、联系、隐私、条款页都在,能从页脚到达
items.title_en: About, contact, privacy and terms pages exist and are linked from the footer

items.title: 上线 28 天后看 CWV 实测(LCP、INP、CLS)
items.title_en: Check field CWV (LCP, INP, CLS) 28 days after launch
